rationale: The T+1 forecast for BrazilCo's BRL operating account (ACC-BR-OPER-01) shows a projected shortfall of 80,000 BRL below the required minimum. An internal transfer of 80,000 BRL from the BrazilCo reserve account (ACC-BR-RES-01), which has sufficient balance, will restore the operating account to the required minimum. This uses eligible same-entity funds and does not require FX or cross-entity movement.
